acceptance_repairs.given: A detached positive Probe is evaluated with independently materialized input, actual-target, command, result, and output bindings; invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence is also available.
acceptance_repairs.when: The replay verifier evaluates the detached positive Probe evidence and invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence.
acceptance_repairs.then: The detached positive Probe is accepted only with a passing terminal result and complete independent bindings; invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence cannot substitute for any required Probe binding.

oracle.observable: The validation result reports the positive Probe terminal result and its input, actual-target, command, result, and output bindings, and identifies any absent detached-Probe binding when Matrix-Case evidence is offered as a substitute.
oracle.expected: The detached positive Probe has a passing terminal result with independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence; invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence is rejected as a substitute for those bindings.
forbidden: An invalid-package Matrix Case is accepted as proof of the detached Probe oracle.
Matrix-Case evidence alone satisfies a missing detached-Probe binding.
A detached positive Probe is accepted without a passing terminal result.
A detached positive Probe is accepted without independently bound input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
